detail: the property may be absent and may be null, and the document says those are different; both become `None`. The type is reached from a response body, so a caller cannot tell an explicit null from an absent member

the parameter is an exploded `form` object, whose members travel under their own names with the parameter's name erased, so the generated handler can never see it; it is optional, so the handler runs with the member always absent

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches is an object that accepts the payloads of a later one, which is tried after it and so never reached, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first
